page.layout: One page of text, printed page number and running head at the top; epigram headings and verse stanzas in the body; a few faint marks at the edges are not text.

main_text.head: In Pseudepiscopos.
main_text.p:
Itrati quocunque ferant vestigia patres,
Prælata apparent aurea signa crucis:
Sive adstant aris, stulto mirante popello,
Vna illis cura est ingeminare cruces:
Sive domo egressi priuata negotia curant.
Mille manu signant seruicolore cruces:
Vdere sæpe etiam, scortari & stertere sæpe,
Et medias inter credo cacare cruces,
Si causam rogitès, id non facit ylla tuendi
Cura gregis. Christi cura nec ylla crucis,
Verù homines natos cruciadis omnibus, æquum est
In manibus propras semper habere cruces.
main_text.head: In eosdem.
main_text.p:
Nil mirum est statuas Dos commendare libenter,
Ipsi quum sitis Pontifices statuæ.
main_text.head: In Cyclopicam ἀπεωφαγίαν.
main_text.p:
Aras atque focos ut defendere Quirites,
Summa quibus pietas ara focúsque fuit:
Sic horum soboles, pro carne & sanguine certat.
Quorsum aras etenim, velsine carne focos?

page.notes: Some words are doubtful in the scan: "Vdere" and "Quirites" as printed; the ligature forms "ylla" and "Dos" are uncertain readings of & or the printed symbol. The Greek heading "ἀπεωφαγίαν" is printed as best read.
